integrity: Every formula is derived by burning-state counting and legal toppling classification for all integers n>=2. The bundled standard-library checker implements independent finite-state tests, which corroborate rather than replace the infinite proof. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact one-chip source-resolved stationary Abelian-sandpile law on unweighted K_{2,n}, sink in the n-vertex part; no claim for arbitrary bipartite sizes, different sink classes, nonrecurrent initial laws, weighted edges or critical scaling on spatial lattices. Prior full-avalanche coefficient and recurrent-state characterization are known; the new claim is the joint exact pair of full source polynomials and rare binomial middle component. Historical priority is provisional pending independent literature review.
title: An all-or-none avalanche law with a rare binomial bridge on \(K_{2,n}\)
